The loudest sound any animal makes is not a roar — it is a click. Blue whale, howler monkey or sperm whale — which did you pick? 👇

Sources: Møhl et al. 2003 (JASA); Frontiers in Marine Science 2021; Current Biology 2015.

youtube.title: What is the loudest animal in the world? Louder than a jet, and it is not a roar 🔊
youtube.description:
The biggest animal, the loudest monkey, or the third one? The loudest sound any animal makes was measured in the far north, and it lasts a fraction of a millisecond. It comes from an enormous nose, and the animal uses it to hunt in total darkness, 2 kilometres down.
Guess before the map lights up, then see the three loudest voices side by side and where the record was recorded.
Which did you pick?
